task: Draft a refill order for this patient's antihypertensive medication.
required_gather: a current creatinine drawn before the refill
rationale: This record carries a creatinine dated 26 days in the FUTURE (a post-dated entry, which happens in real charts) and the next one is 345 days old. With a 30-day window neither qualifies, so the resolution is to gather. An implementation comparing the absolute age would accept the future row -- abs(-26) <= 30 -- and act on a result that does not exist yet. Probe of the lower bound in protocol item 1.
